app_fee.value: International applicants pay a non-refundable CAD 130 application fee (domestic CAD 100); the application is evaluated only after payment.
app_fee.quote: International student application fee: $130 CDN | The application fee is non-refundable. | Your application to the university will be evaluated only after we have received your payment.

fee_waiver.value: The Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies pages describe the fee but no application-fee waiver.

gre_general.value: No university-wide GRE rule; some departments may ask for the GRE, so check the program record.
gre_general.quote: Some departments may have higher standards and additional criteria. These may include confirmation from a prospective supervisor; admissions tests such as the Graduate Record Examination (GRE)

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 86 overall with at least 20 in each section for tests taken up to January 20, 2026; for tests from January 21, 2026, 4.5 overall with 4.0 in each section. Scores from a single sitting only; tests older than two years are invalid.
toefl_min.quote: For tests taken up to January 20, 2026: Overall score of 86 20 in Reading 20 in Writing 20 in Listening 20 in Speaking | For tests taken on or after January 21, 2026: Overall score of 4.5 4.0 in Reading

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall (PTE Academic 61 and Duolingo 120 are also accepted).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS (Academic module) (International English Language Testing System) 6.5 overall

english_waiver.value: Only degrees or diplomas from Canada or the listed exemption countries waive the test; India is not on the list, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants holding secondary school diplomas and/or university degrees from the following countries are exempt from the English Language Proficiency Test requirement.

notes: Faculty of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies sets fee and English rules for all programs; departments add supervisor and other requirements.
